pathways.title: CAK consumer complaint information
pathways.overview: CAK publishes a process for consumer complaints.
pathways.whoMayUse: CAK considers complaints within its consumer-protection mandate.
requirements: Review the complaint form and supply relevant complaint information.

startingSteps.title: Contact CAK through a published channel
startingSteps.description: Use the official source for current instructions.

nextStages: CAK may request missing information and assess the complaint.

preparation.label: Review the published complaint scope
preparation.note: Check whether the published guidance addresses your issue.

preparation.label: Review the consumer complaint form
preparation.note: Check the information requested by CAK; do not upload documents here.

preparation.label: Confirm a current contact channel
preparation.note: Use the official CAK page before contacting the service.

pathways.title: Small Claims Court information
pathways.overview: Published court information describes certain civil claims.
pathways.whoMayUse: Confirm current jurisdiction and requirements with the court; a category selection cannot establish eligibility.
matters: Contracts involving money held or received
requirements: Check current jurisdiction, forms and filing instructions with the Judiciary.

startingSteps.title: Consult the official forms page
startingSteps.description: Confirm current filing instructions with the relevant court.

preparation.label: Review current court jurisdiction
preparation.note: Confirm claim type and applicable limits using the official overview.

preparation.label: Review the official forms
preparation.note: Confirm the appropriate form and required information with the court.

preparation.label: Confirm current filing instructions
preparation.note: This checklist does not file a claim or preserve a deadline.

pathways.title: NLAS legal aid application information
pathways.overview: NLAS publishes application and eligibility guidance.
pathways.whoMayUse: NLAS assesses eligibility. Its listed exclusions include debt recovery.
requirements: Check NLAS eligibility and income-evidence requirements.

preparation.label: Review eligibility and exclusions
preparation.note: Debt recovery is among the published exclusions.

preparation.label: Check income-evidence requirements
preparation.note: Confirm with NLAS what evidence applies; do not upload it here.

preparation.label: Review official application instructions
preparation.note: Opening this checklist does not apply for aid.
